steps.label: Tell me what happened
steps.text: I'm Clara. I'll guide you step by step. Tell me what happened, or tap the injury below.

steps.label: Check it is safe and put on gloves
steps.text: First, make sure it is safe for you to go to them. Put on the gloves from the lit compartment.

steps.label: Alert help now
steps.text: Heavy bleeding can be life-threatening. I'm alerting help now. If someone is with you, ask them to call for emergency help too.

steps.label: Find where the blood is coming from
steps.text: Find where the blood is coming from. Open or cut away clothing so you can see the wound. Use the shears in the lit compartment.

steps.label: Arm or leg: apply the tourniquet
steps.text: On an arm or leg, use the tourniquet. Place it high on the limb, a hand's width above the wound, not on a joint. Pull the strap tight.

steps.label: Twist the rod until bleeding stops
steps.text: Twist the rod until the bleeding stops, then lock the rod in its clip. It will hurt. That is expected. Do not loosen it.

steps.label: Still bleeding: add a second tourniquet
steps.text: If it is still bleeding, put the second tourniquet on just above the first one and tighten it the same way.

steps.label: Body, neck or groin: pack the wound
steps.text: If the wound is on the body, neck, armpit or groin, pack it. Push the gauze from the lit compartment deep into the wound until it is full.

steps.label: Press hard on the wound
steps.text: Put gauze on the wound and press down hard with both hands, using your body weight.

steps.label: Keep pressing for 3 minutes
steps.text: Keep pressing hard with both hands for at least 3 minutes. Do not lift your hands to look.

steps.label: Wrap the pressure bandage
steps.text: Wrap the pressure bandage tightly over the gauze to keep the pressure on.

steps.label: Keep them warm and stay with them
steps.text: Cover them with the emergency blanket to keep them warm. Stay with them, keep them still, and watch their breathing.

steps.label: Show the summary to whoever arrives
steps.text: When help arrives, show them this screen. It has what happened and when each step was done.

questions.text: Where is the bleeding: an arm, a leg, or the body, neck or groin?
Are they awake and talking to you?

care.note: Fictional demo threshold, not medical guidance.
